name: Fueled by Wolves
source:
Today's your lucky day! You, the player, have found a button that, when pressed, will summon a wolf husband just for you! At least, that's what a pair of kitsune brothers told you it does. ... Wait... wait no why is someone eating it?!

Well, it's not too bad, right? More and more wolves are showing up and... Hold up, aren't wolves supposed to be super muscular? Well, whatever. Beggars can't be choosers. Err... assuming that's what you even wanted in the first place.

Fueled by Wolves is a short parody vn made specifically for April Fool's and features wolves from various different visual novels. While this is a SFW visual novel, most of the source material is not, so keep that in mind if you choose to download and play any of these.

[From [url=https://xarishro.itch.io/fueled-by-wolves]Itch.io[/url]]
